newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 28.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Sega Enterprises Ltd and Bandai Co Ltd call off their planned merger.
-- Toyota Motor Corp group and Sony Corp basically agree on joint production and sales of next-generation liquid crystal displays (LCD).
-- Government to freeze plan for capital's relocation from Tokyo.
-- Nissan Motor Co Ltd posts consolidated net profit for the first time in five years.
-- Nomura Securities Co Ltd former president Hideo Sakamaki met corporate racketeer Koike while serving as company president.
-- All Nippon Airways Co Ltd chairman Takaya Sugiura to resign.
